description: Log one food to the diary; this changes the account. Take food_id from search_foods. Give either grams, or a quantity of a measure (measure_id from get_food_details; defaults to the food’s default measure). The result carries the serving_id.

date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

diary_group.description: Diary group 1–4 (by default Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks).

food_id.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.

grams.description: Total weight in grams. Use this or quantity.

quantity.description: How many of the chosen measure, e.g. 2 for "2 large eggs".

name: add_food_entry
title: Log Food
